rules.rule_text:
import "pe"

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_DLL
{
	meta:
		description = "Cobalt Strike Beacon DLL (x86/x64) based on PE structure and import profile"
		author = "Paul Melson (pmelson)"
		date = "2026-10-21"
		reference_sample = "0193c6130fc55895ff42dd9d08aa785067ccd56e3aabf6c2e15e26922ba09a8b"

	condition:
		pe.is_dll( ) and pe.imports ( "kernel32.dll" , "ConnectNamedPipe" ) and pe.imports ( "kernel32.dll" , "SetThreadContext" ) and pe.imports ( "kernel32.dll" , "GetComputerNameA" ) and pe.imports ( "kernel32.dll" , "VirtualAllocEx" ) and pe.imports ( "kernel32.dll" , "WriteProcessMemory" ) and pe.imports ( "kernel32.dll" , "CreateRemoteThread" ) and pe.imports ( "ws2_32.dll" , "WSAStartup" ) and pe.imports ( "ws2_32.dll" , "connect" ) and pe.imports ( "ws2_32.dll" , "bind" ) and pe.imports ( "ws2_32.dll" , "listen" ) and pe.number_of_resources == 0 and pe.characteristics & pe.BYTES_REVERSED_HI and pe.size_of_code * 2 > pe.size_of_image
}
